description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`) for the workflow pairs of point 3, played apart from the cases. `a-night-that-skips-a-gate` fires `night-skips-a-target`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant: over `_reference` without its `rule`, a case that passed, which only the PASSED rule reports when the case declares no rule; with `rule` set to `night-line-empty`, another rule. Point 3 fires one rule at most — each of its readings returns or fires once — so the runner's rule that a case fires one rule alone is reported by the rule comparison and needs no variant here.
